entities.text: STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH STATION HOUSE
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.57/2023 registered at Police Station Juni Indore, District Indore (M.P.) for the offence under Section 420, 406 and 409 of IPC on the ground that the applicant is ready to pay /
deposit Rs. 20 lacs to the complainant as the actual transaction is not more than Rs. 20 lacs and the applicant is in jail since 04/10/2023
, hence it is prayed that the applicant be enlarged on bail.
2/ On the other hand, learned counsel for the State as well as counsel for the objector opposed the application and prays for its rejection.

3/ Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of the allegations and also taking note of the fact that the applicant's first bail application was dismissed on merit vide Dinesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111724739/
1 order dated 08/11/2023 after considering all the facts and circumstances of the case ; at the time of consideration of earlier bail application, it has been mentioned that the complainant has paid about Rs.1 crore to the applicant through different installments for supply of Heineken beer, but that was not supplied as per the agreement.

entities.text: Dinesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
and is is also mentioned that the applicant committed fraud of Rs.1 crore; the applicant is having criminal antecedents, which have been registered in Gujrat and Rajasthan; in view of the aforesaid, there is no material change in circumstances after passing the earlier order, therefore, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
4/ Accordingly, this second bail application filed under section 439 of Cr.P.C has no force and is hereby dismissed.

(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE amol Dinesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111724739/
